result.topic_en: An addition to the second section of the theory of Abelian functions: substituting algebraic integrals for the variables of the theta function gives a function of z on the cut surface; the page treats the behaviour of its derivatives across the cuts, its p zeros, the congruence relating the zeros to the arguments e, and an expression for the constants K_ν.
